lobby_ui_regression.symptom: PVP/PVE/ranked buttons greyed out, task icons grey, GP shown as unknown, no character card, after the forced stop of round 8

lobby_ui_regression.fix: tools/launch_1649370.py now rewrites the native cache (profile_data+68) from the account profile's characterClasses.<currentCharacterIndex>.slots.0 and retries the bridge
lobby_ui_regression.verified: round 21 screenshot shows coloured mode tiles, GP 1999951600, CP 1520 and a character card; runs/codex-ring-bridge-21-lobby.png
